## Weekly report review

This automated pull request contains a data-derived weekly report draft and charts.

Before publishing:

- verify the week, returns, observations, and calculation flags;
- replace the editor-notes placeholder with reviewed commentary;
- confirm every claim is supported by the structured report data;
- change the report status to `published` and add `publishedAt` only after review;
- keep the listing-price and non-transaction-price disclosure intact.

Merging a report while it remains `draft` does not expose it on the public site.
